component: SparkFun heating pad 5 cm x 10 cm 5 V
notes: Resistive heating element used as actuator
1-Wire digital probe; data line on D7 with 4.7 kohm pull-up to +5 V
Logic-level gate; switches the heater current
Pull-down on the MOSFET gate (D9 to GND)
Pull-up on the DS18B20 data line (D7 to +5 V)
Start trigger on D2 to GND (firmware uses INPUT_PULLUP)
Mixed M-M and M-F leads for breadboard wiring
